title: Environment
description: Canonical environment/location definition. One file per environment in the environments/ directory.

environment_id.description: Immutable slug. Must match the filename (e.g. city_exterior.yaml -> city_exterior).

description.description: Full prose description. For human reference and validation layer prompts.

identity.description: Canonical description inserted verbatim into generation request prompts.

exclusions.description: Negative prompt tokens specific to this environment.

references.description: Optional reference images for this environment. May be empty.

file.description: Path to the reference image, relative to the environments/ directory.

purpose.description: Semantic role of this reference image.
